{{Quote|My time at Raithal wasn't pleasant, but I left there a true soldier.|[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]|<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Raithal Academy''', also known as the '''Imperial Army Academy''', '''Raithal Military Academy''',<ref name="TAB-SB">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref> and '''Raithal Army Academy''',<ref name="Rhamalai">{{JournalCite|13|The Occupation of Rhamalai}}</ref> was a prestigious school that trained citizens to serve in the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was later assimilated into the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] and remained one of its most prestigious branches, along with the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] and [[Corulag Academy]]. The Raithal Academy's attendees were trained for service in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Imperial_Cadet.jpg|thumb|A [[Cadet/Legends|cadet]] of the Raithal Academy]]
Recruits spent a year at the Academy. In Imperial times, the experience would include indoctrination in the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], a thousand hours in tactical simulators, survival in a sixteen-day mock siege,<ref name="SW:DV&GP">''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Ghost Prison]]''</ref> and a week spent in simulated interrogation which occasionally killed recruits.

Raithal's [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] training consisted of [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] familiarizing themselves with hardware such as ground-based [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] and vehicles including the [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut]], the [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortress]], the [[PX-4 Mobile Command Base]], and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]]. Trainees commonly demonstrated their abilities in full-immersion [[Hologram/Legends|holo-simulations]] against enemy targets.<ref name="GG3">''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref> It also had large live-fire training grounds.<ref name="Handbook" /> The Academy was also home to a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Navy/Legends|naval]] school that trained attendees in [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] helm tactics.<ref name="CCG-Helmsman">{{CCG|set=Dagobah Limited|cardname=Imperial Helmsman}}</ref>

[[Caul Gentis]], [[Shens]] and [[Laurita Tohm]] were graduates of the Raithal Academy months after the [[Declaration of a New Order]]. That same time, the Academy was also involved in a military [[Ghost Prison incident|coup]] against the newly-made [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] orchestrated by [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmaster]] [[Gentis]].<ref name="SW:DV&GP" />

During an inspection tour of the Academy sometime during the assembling of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] noted the considerable skills of a cadet named [[Nyrox/Legends|Nyrox]], who astutely took a defensive, kneeling position in an AT-AT, allowing simulated enemy craft come to him, rather than seeking to hunt them down. Nyrox was able to destroy each craft. He was awarded the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] straight out of the Academy and was personally selected by Veers to [[TIE pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Thunderer One]], the lead [[Walker/Legends|walker]] of his AT-AT fleet, [[Thundering Herd/Legends|Thundering Herd]].<ref name="GG3" />

Shortly before the [[battle of Talus]], a small Rebel force led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Coret Bhan]] led a hit-and-run [[attack on the Raithal Academy]]. A Rebel strike force has landed just outside the Academy and&mdash;without trying to capture or destroy it&mdash;tried to disrupt Imperial planning in preparation for the operation in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. When the cadets of the Academy put up reasonable defense, Rebel forces fell back in good order towards their landing craft, leaving behind some explosives which they planned to use to blow the starport on their way out.<ref>{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

In [[42 ABY]], [[Richeu]] served as [[Commander/Legends|commandant]] of the Raithal Academy.<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Prior to the development of the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]] in the [[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy|''Jedi Academy Trilogy'']], the Raithal Academy was established as the most prestigious branch of the Imperial Academy.
